Noether_1908.title: Über die Bildung des Formensystems der ternären biquadratischen Form
Noether_1908.author: Emmy Noether
Noether_1908.journal: Journal für die reine und angewandte Mathematik 134 (1908), pp. 23ff.
source_supported_points: relatively complete systems are built recursively by reduction to higher modules/forms
double reduction of an expression with two independent reducers produces relations among the higher forms
systematic double reduction is presented both as a relation-producing method and as a calculation/independence control
Noether_1908.guard: Noether 1908 is not asserted to contain Selling field incidence, Thomas-Wigner physics, or the Gamma_3(2) presentation used here.

requirements: logical truth versus certification status separation

E: projective CRT tower proofs and finite replay
